rules.analysis: Meal preparation, anticipation of the husband's preferences, domestic service.
Appearance, grooming and the expectation of attractiveness for the husband's arrival.
Pleasantness, conversation and emotional responsibility for improving his mood.
Household order and cleaning assigned to the wife.
Preparing comfort and rest, including the fireplace in cold months.
Children's grooming and presentation assigned to the mother.
Silencing household appliances and children to protect his rest.
Smiling, pleasing him and treating her happiness as reward for his work.
His topics and opportunity to speak are prioritized over hers.
Tolerance of lateness, outings without her and not returning home overnight.
Her problems are minimized against his workday difficulties.
Drink, pillow, shoes and soft voice: intensified service and comfort.

rules.source: Una buena esposa siempre sabe cuál es su lugar
rules.analysis: Closing slogan explicitly condenses the hierarchy and gender subordination.
